title: hangs indefinitely when executed from Node.js `child_process` (subprocess)

linked_prs.title: fix(cli): improve stdin handling and add initial state check
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Fixes Gemini CLI hanging indefinitely when executed from Node.js `child_process` (subprocess) by adding intelligent stdin state detection to `readStdin()`. The fix preserves the ability to combine `-p` flag with stdin input while preventing infinite waits in subprocess environments.

## Dive Deeper

This addresses a critical regression introduced in v0.1.22 where the CLI would hang indefinitely when spawned as a Node.js subprocess. The root cause was that `readStdin()` would unconditionally wait for stdin input in non-TTY environments, but subprocess stdin streams aren't properly closed by default, causing infinite blocking.

**Key improvements to `readStdin()`:**
- **Initial state detection**: Checks if stdin is already ended/destroyed before waiting
- **Non-blocking data check**: Uses `process.stdin.read()` to detect immediately available data
- **Smart timeout mechanism**: Only applies 50ms timeout when no data has been received; once data starts flowing, waits normally for complete input
- **Subprocess detection**: Identifies when stdin is not readable (typical subprocess scenario)

This solution maintains backward compatibility with:
- Terminal usage (direct CLI execution)
- Pipe operations (`echo "data" | gemini -p "prompt"`)
- Combined stdin + `-p` flag usage (introduced in PR #4406)

## Reviewer Test Plan

**Quick validation:**
```bash
# Build the project
npm run build

# Test subprocess execution (should complete quickly, not hang)
node -e "
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const child = spawn('node', ['packages/cli/dist/src/gemini.js', '-y', '-m', 'gemini-2.5-flash', '-p', 'hello']);
child.stdin.end();
child.on('close', (code) => console.log('Exit code:', code));
setTimeout(() => { child.kill(); console.log('TIMEOUT - Fix failed!'); }, 5000);
"

# Test normal stdin functionality still works
echo "context data" | node packages/cli/dist/src/gemini.js -y -m gemini-2.5-flash -p "analyze this"
```

**Expected results:**
- Subprocess test completes in <1 second with exit code 0
- Stdin + prompt combination works normally
